title: Host Resources Disappear After Creation
suspected_issue: writer.SyncHosts() with ConditionOnlyOperation deletes k8s_metadata instead of updating
test_cases: Create Host -> stays alive for 5 minutes
No spurious DELETE operations in outbox
k8s_metadata not deleted on status update
Create 10 Hosts simultaneously -> all stay alive

evidence.database_state: Host deleted (0 rows), orphaned outbox CREATE entry
evidence.kubectl_behavior: Host shows at T+2s, NotFound at T+10s

root_cause_hypothesis: markEntityResourceReady() calls writer.SyncHosts() with ConditionOnlyOperation flag, but implementation deletes k8s_metadata row instead of only updating conditions. This triggers CASCADE DELETE on hosts table due to FK constraint. Cascade delete fires trigger_host_before_delete() which creates DELETE outbox entry, Worker processes it, and Host disappears.
recommended_fix: Option A - Fix writer.SyncHosts() to respect ConditionOnlyOperation and NEVER delete k8s_metadata when only updating conditions
